definition.given: The person is viewing PR 79490 Empty Dashboard, which has no cards or other exportable content.
definition.when: The person opens the Share menu to attempt PDF export and invokes Export as PDF if it is offered as an executable action.
definition.observed: No PDF file is generated, but a download notification reports `Done!` and `Download completed`; the console warns `No dashboard content found #Dashboard-Parameters-And-Cards-Container`.
definition.require: For an empty dashboard, PDF export is unavailable or an export attempt is stopped with a clear explanation that there is no content to export. Download-completion feedback corresponds to an actually produced PDF.
allow: Hiding the export entry, disabling it with an explanation, or showing a clear no-content message when it is selected are all acceptable, provided no download starts. Message wording and presentation may vary.
Non-empty dashboards or selected tabs may retain PDF export.
The empty dashboard and its editing controls may remain unchanged.

theory.title: Responsive Enabling
theory.reference: Designing Interfaces, Third Edition, Chapter 4: Layout of Screen Elements; designing-interfaces/chapters/ch04-layout.md
theory.rationale: Exportable content is a prerequisite for producing this report. The interface should make export unavailable or explain why the action cannot proceed when that prerequisite is missing.

theory.title: Interactions Are Conversations
theory.reference: Designing Interfaces, Third Edition, Chapter 1: Designing for People; designing-interfaces/chapters/ch01-designing-for-people.md
theory.rationale: Action feedback should communicate the actual outcome and a useful next step. A download-completed message without a generated PDF misrepresents the result.

reference_observation: The empty dashboard's Share menu omits Export as PDF, and no download-completion notification appears.
requirement_rationale: Dashboard PDF export lets users share the dashboard’s content as a report. An empty dashboard has no report content to export. Making export unavailable prevents an unproductive action and avoids misleading users into believing a report was downloaded.
